name: touch-s2r-m4
description: #120 stretch 2 probe (owner's third budget: route over md1_1's walkmesh), generated by runner/test/unit/playthrough-scenarios.js; boots from touch-md1-1 (stretch 1's end, kept by touch-playthrough). Input: wait 30 frames; route to talk range of model 4, at most 3000 frames; 10 still frames; Interact for 4 frames; 40 still frames. End check: still field mode. Metrics: out, rframes (route frames), legs, l0, l1, l2, and w0, w1 (raw window states at the end: 6 is a message waiting). Route outcome codes: 1 reached, 2 stuck, 3 timeout, 4 left field mode, 5 no walkmesh, 6 no goal, 7 no path. A leg is direction code (0 up, clockwise to 7 up-left) * 10000 + frames. Only those numbers, small state values and the field ID leave.
